 fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 4))
bins   = np.linspace(0, 100, 21)
bw     = bins[1] - bins[0]
colors = ['sandybrown', 'slategray', 'peru']

for ax, (name, v), col in zip(axes, variables.items(), colors):
    counts, edges = np.histogram(v, bins=bins)
    density = counts / (len(v) * bw)
    ax.bar(edges[:-1], density, width=bw, align='edge',
           color=col, alpha=0.6, edgecolor='white', label='Histogram')
    kde_x = np.linspace(max(-5, v.min() - 10), min(105, v.max() + 10), 300)
    kde   = stats.gaussian_kde(v, bw_method=0.3)
    ax.plot(kde_x, kde(kde_x), 'r-', lw=2, label='KDE')
    ax.set_xlabel(f'{name} (%)'); ax.set_ylabel('Density')
    ax.set_title(f'{name} - histogram &amp; KDE'); ax.legend()

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

CELL 12 
 def ecdf(x):
    xs = np.sort(x)
    ps = np.arange(1, len(xs) + 1) / len(xs)
    return xs, ps

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 4))

for ax, (name, v), col in zip(axes, variables.items(), colors):
    xs, ps = ecdf(v)
    ax.step(xs, ps, color='steelblue', lw=2, label='Empirical CDF', where='post')
    kde_x = np.linspace(-5, 105, 600)
    kde_p = np.cumsum(stats.gaussian_kde(v, bw_method=0.3)(kde_x)) * (kde_x[1] - kde_x[0])
    ax.plot(kde_x, np.clip(kde_p, 0, 1), 'r-', lw=2, label='KDE CDF')
    ax.set_xlabel(f'{name} (%)'); ax.set_ylabel('F(z)')
    ax.set_title(f'{name} - CDF'); ax.set_xlim([0, 100]); ax.legend()

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
